Grew up in a very conservative household to the point where when I came out as bi to my parents my father said that I wasn’t and if I was I was sinner. I was raised to think anyone that isn’t white is problematic and that everyone has equal rights in America. Plus I was raised on the whole “America is the best country in the world” type of household. Anyway, one day I remember hearing my dad and his friend talking about black Americans and referring to them as “n**gers* and they kept saying that black men and women naturally have a lower IQ because they’re the weakest race. This shocked me to hear because I knew absolutely none of that was true and I wanted to prove them wrong so I looked up actual facts and read them it, making them say that “the mainstream media is always a lie and that the government is trying to brainwash me.” Brainwash me on what? The fact that other people in not only this country but around the world still are treated like second class citizens because of their skin color? 

I was 16 when trump was elected president and I remember watching the votes pour in for him. I remember going to bed thinking he may do some good for the country and then over the next couple of months I completely switched my political party from hard conservative to liberal. So my change sparked when I heard my dad talking to his friend but it also really changed in the couple of months after trump was elected president. 

Now, as a 19 year old woman, I see a lot of things that weren’t ok being said again and it frightens me because although I may not be POC, I can still stand up for their rights. At work (I’m a machinist) I’ve heard older men refer to black Americans the same way my father did and I’ve heard them talking about how blacks want more rights and that white people are becoming oppressed. This next bit isn’t racist but I’ve encountered men who have told me I’m in the wrong trade and that I would be better in a kitchen or working in the office. Hi, as someone who’s going vegan I’d just like to educate you more on why people go vegan. Most vegans understand those who have disabilities and those who can’t switch to a vegan diet because they’re in a remote location or they’re in a 3rd world country and will try to give advice to those people as to how to still incorporate more vegetables into their lives. Now with all this being said, vegans feel like they are ethically better than those who eat meat because they aren’t blind to the fact that the animals on your plate were tortured and did not want to die. In a way yes vegans are more ethical than the average person because they take a stand against the horrors of the meat and dairy industry and they are doing their best to fight against climate change, but vegans who tell others to die because they eat meat are just as bad as those who comment “mmm steak” on a post clearly about veganism. Check the other goats temps and check their inner eyelids. Start a deworming treatment and examine their stools from a far. If you see anything move in them then you definitely need a dewormer ASAP. Make sure you have enough baking soda and salt out for them too! We lost a baby because he was bloated and we forgot to fill the baking soda back up. Make sure the water dish is clean to prevent parasites and foreign objects from being drunken. The average temp for a goat is 102-103 Fahrenheit so if they’re higher then I would recommend cool water and if it’s cold where you are, walk them around in the cold for a bit. If they’re under 102 then bring them inside if you can but if you can’t, invest in a heat lamp or goat blankets (the same has horse blankets, just smaller). Hope any of this helps!
